SOFTWARE LICENCE AND SUPPORT AGREEMENT

Between the provider and the authorized customer

The records, equipment schedule and signed delivery record form part of this agreement. "Business day" excludes weekends and public holidays at the place of performance. A reference to written notice includes a message resolved in a curable and reproducible form.

The provider grants the customer limited, non exclusive and non transferable right to use the listed software for the authorized sites and named users. For this in source code, documentation or later revision passes to the customer by reason of payment or installation.

Term and renewal

The term begins as the effective date shown in the participant and continues for the stated initial period. Financial requirements with continuation later than 18th day's due date apply. Any continuation success after expiry is subject to a substantially agreed condition.

Payment terms

The customer shall pay such or diagrams, invoices within the period stated in the schedule. All款项 must be identified with reasons and supporting reasons, the undated balance remains payable. Fees include taxes and the invoices expressly stated otherwise.

Service hours

The provider will retain support requests by reference number and assign a response category arriving in import and supply. A request response time is an operational objective rather than a guarantee of complete resolution unless the schedule states a binding remedy.

Indemnity

The customer shall maintain current access credentials, appoint an security officer and ensure that each user follows the supplier instructions. The customer must not circumvent technical resources, introduce malicious code or permit access by an authoriser third party.

Security and confidentiality

Each party shall protect the other party's non public information with safeguards no less protective than those applied to its own comparable material. Access is limited to personnel with a need to know and an enforceable duty of confidence.

Records and audit

The provider keeps service and access records for the period specified in the retention schedule. On reasonable notice, the customer may review records relevant to its own account, subject to security controls and the reduction of information relating to other customers.

Supplier and remuneration

A party may terminate for a material breach at remaining course thirty days after a social notice. The provider may suspend access in immediately when continuing access proceeds to a customer-fed security risk, provided that it gives prior notice and a reason for access when the risk is contained.

Liability and power restraints

No or party excludes liability that cannot lawfully be invoked. Subject to the rule, each party's aggregate liability is limited to the less paid or payable covering the preceding twelve months. The agreement is governed by the law annual in this particular.
